topic: Fuel accounting with own facility, fueling parent aircraft, fueling aircraft from other unit, fueling aircraft from other sources, fueling with IAF, fueling done by IOC accounting and audit, quality control / checks on fuel.
syllabus_extract: Fuel accounting with own facility, fueling parent aircraft, fueling aircraft from other unit, fueling aircraft from other sources, fueling with IAF, fueling done by IOC accounting and audit, quality control / checks on fuel.
specific_objectives: 4.1.7.1 Trainee will be able to describe fuel accounting procedure, quality checks on fuel and list out aviation returns & their occurrence

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of fuel accounting forms and verification of quality check records against standard operating procedures.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of fuel accounting in aviation operations?
List the different sources from which an aircraft can be fueled.
Why is quality control essential before fueling an aircraft?

development.content:
Fuel accounting with own facility
Fueling parent aircraft procedures
Fueling aircraft from other unit
Fueling aircraft from other sources

Fueling with IAF procedures
IOC accounting and audit processes
Quality control checks on fuel

Aviation returns and their occurrence
Documentation requirements for fueling
Review of fuel accounting forms

summary_questions: Describe the key steps involved in fueling an aircraft from an external unit.
Explain the role of the IOC in fuel accounting and audit.
What are the critical quality control checks performed on aviation fuel?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the periodicity and types of aviation returns related to fuel operations to be discussed in the next lesson.

pft_rows.syllabus: Induction to various aviation returns rendered with periodicity.
